contracts.name: requirement-1-read
names: R1.1 records payer, whole-cent amount and what for each line
R1.2 shares a split line among the listed names and other lines among everyone
R1.3 treats names that differ in case or spaces as one person with the first spelling
R1.4 stops with the line number and one plain sentence for a bad line
R1.5 skips empty lines and lines that start with #

contracts.name: requirement-2-split
names: R2.1 gives each sharer the floor and the extra cents to the first names alphabetically
R2.2 makes balances paid minus shares and sums them to exactly zero

contracts.name: requirement-3-settle
names: R3.1 produces positive whole-cent payments that bring every balance to zero
R3.2 pays from the biggest debtor to the biggest creditor, ties by name, same every run
R3.3 prints All square. and no payments when every balance is zero

contracts.name: requirement-4-cli
names: R4.1 prints the balances table then one pays line per payment with two decimals
R4.2 prints balances and payments as JSON with amounts in integer cents
R4.3 exits 1 with one plain sentence when the file is missing or unreadable

4.text: 4. Split one expense to the cent (Req 2.1)
